newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila to sell PNOC geothermal unit.
newsitem.headline: Manila to sell PNOC geothermal unit.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos has approved the privatisation of PNOC-Energy Development Corp (PNOC-EDC) in the second half of the year, Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo said on Wednesday.
PNOC-EDC is the geothermal exploration arm of the state-owned Philippine National Oil Co.
Under the privatisation plan, the PNOC will initially sell 30 to 40 percent of the company through an initial public offering, and 20 to 30 percent to a strategic investor.
The government would retain 40 percent ownership of the firm.
De Ocampo said the investors will have to prioritise geothermal exploration and development and should not engage in the generation, transmission and distribution of power.
No price has yet been set for the sale of the firm.
According to the Department of Finance, PNOC-EDC had assets worth 35 billion pesos and a net income of about 797 million pesos in 1996.
Morgan Stanley is the financial advisor of PNOC-EDC.
